name: LRB US Tour — Madison Square Garden Performance
notes: LRB undertook a second US tour in 2000 (their first was in 1998, covering 7 states) and is cited as the only Bangladeshi rock band to have performed at Madison Square Garden. Exact date within 2000 and the specific tour leg require further primary-source verification; this entry should be treated as approximate pending confirmation from tour archives or contemporaneous press.
